questions.subject: US_GOVERNMENT

questions.stem: A chef costing a recipe notes that both the union and the state levy a sales tax on the same dish; which power is concurrent?

questions.explanation: The enumeration of federal powers leaves remaining authority with the states. A licence for restaurants is not delegated upward, so it stays reserved.

questions.topic: Continuing resolution
questions.stem: A chef costing a recipe asks whether a continuing resolution replaces a full appropriation permanently.

answer.exemplar: No, a continuing resolution is temporary and keeps prior funding levels until a new appropriation is enacted.

questions.explanation: A continuing resolution is temporary, not a permanent replacement. Treating it as permanent misstates its role.

options.text: No, the funds must be spent
